annotations.title: Update a sheet copied from a template

description: For a sheet copied from a shared template sheet (copiedFrom in list_tracks): which version of the template it's on, the newest, and what updating adds, tab by tab. change new: the newer version adds the tab. changed: its author changed the tab, so the new version is added beside the sheet's own as addAs ("Budget (version 3)") for the person to compare. removed_by_you: the person deleted the tab, so it isn't brought back. columns says what happens to the data tab's header row: update writes the worked-out columns (formulas in row 1) the author changed, and headers of columns they added, by letter; yours: the person changed those cells too, so the row is left; unknown: the row is left. Rows are never written, and nothing else already in the sheet is changed, overwritten or removed. Without apply it only looks. With apply true it updates: tell the person what it adds and apply only when they say so.

apply.description: true updates the sheet; leave out to only look.
